name: Cora
description: A citation-network benchmark containing scientific publications as nodes and citation links as edges, commonly used for node classification. This record is the third Planetoid companion to CiteSeer and PubMed; the standard Planetoid split may be used, but this record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Sen, P., Namata, G., Bilgic, M., Getoor, L., Gallagher, B., & Eliassi-Rad, T. (2008). Collective classification in network data. AI Magazine, 29(3), 93–106. https://doi.org/10.1609/aimag.v29i3.2157
